import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.util.*;

public final class NumericVariants {
    private NumericVariants() {}
    public static long floorCubeRoot(long n) {
        long l = -2_097_152, r = 2_097_153;
        BigInteger value = BigInteger.valueOf(n);
        while (l + 1 < r) {
            long m = l + (r - l) / 2;
            if (BigInteger.valueOf(m).pow(3).compareTo(value) <= 0) l = m;
            else r = m;
        }
        return l;
    }
    /** Nonnegative input; halfUp=false truncates, true rounds halfway upward. */
    public static String squareRootThreeDecimals(long n, boolean halfUp) {
        if (n < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("nonnegative radicand");
        BigInteger scaled = BigInteger.valueOf(n).multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(1_000_000));
        BigInteger l = BigInteger.ZERO, r = BigInteger.ONE.shiftLeft((scaled.bitLength() + 1) / 2 + 1);
        while (l.add(BigInteger.ONE).compareTo(r) < 0) {
            BigInteger m = l.add(r).shiftRight(1);
            if (m.multiply(m).compareTo(scaled) <= 0) l = m; else r = m;
        }
        if (halfUp && scaled.shiftLeft(2).compareTo(l.shiftLeft(1).add(BigInteger.ONE).pow(2)) >= 0)
            l = l.add(BigInteger.ONE);
        BigInteger[] pieces = l.divideAndRemainder(BigInteger.valueOf(1000));
        return pieces[0] + "." + String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%03d", pieces[1].intValueExact());
    }
    public static int kthLexicographicalNumber(int n, int k) {
        if (n < 1 || k < 1 || k > n) throw new IllegalArgumentException("1 <= k <= n");
        long prefix = 1; int remaining = k - 1;
        while (remaining > 0) {
            long count = 0, first = prefix, next = prefix + 1;
            while (first <= n) {
                count += Math.min((long) n + 1, next) - first;
                first *= 10; next *= 10;
            }
            if (count <= remaining) { remaining -= (int) count; prefix++; }
            else { prefix *= 10; remaining--; }
        }
        return (int) prefix;
    }
    /** Lexicographic order by integer value. Input values must be distinct. Rank is 1-based. */
    public static List<Integer> kthPermutation(int[] values, BigInteger rank) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(values); Objects.requireNonNull(rank);
        int[] sorted = values.clone(); Arrays.sort(sorted);
        List<Integer> unused = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
            if (i > 0 && sorted[i] == sorted[i - 1]) throw new IllegalArgumentException("distinct values required");
            unused.add(sorted[i]);
        }
        BigInteger[] factorial = new BigInteger[values.length + 1]; factorial[0] = BigInteger.ONE;
        for (int i = 1; i <= values.length; i++) factorial[i] = factorial[i - 1].multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(i));
        if (rank.signum() <= 0 || rank.compareTo(factorial[values.length]) > 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("rank out of range");
        BigInteger r = rank.subtract(BigInteger.ONE);
        List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int left = values.length; left > 0; left--) {
            BigInteger[] division = r.divideAndRemainder(factorial[left - 1]);
            out.add(unused.remove(division[0].intValueExact())); r = division[1];
        }
        return out;
    }
    /** Ring positions 0..8; each step chooses one of two directions. */
    public static BigInteger ringNineReturnWays(int steps) {
        if (steps < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("negative steps");
        BigInteger[] dp = new BigInteger[9]; Arrays.fill(dp, BigInteger.ZERO); dp[0] = BigInteger.ONE;
        for (int s = 0; s < steps; s++) {
            BigInteger[] next = new BigInteger[9];
            for (int p = 0; p < 9; p++) next[p] = dp[(p + 8) % 9].add(dp[(p + 1) % 9]);
            dp = next;
        }
        return dp[0];
    }
    /** Ordered shot outcomes; every score in [minimum,maximum] is available each time. */
    public static BigInteger shotScoreWays(int shots, int total, int minimum, int maximum) {
        if (shots < 0 || total < 0 || minimum < 0 || maximum < minimum || total == Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid bounds");
        if ((long) shots * minimum > total || (long) shots * maximum < total) return BigInteger.ZERO;
        BigInteger[] dp = new BigInteger[total + 1]; Arrays.fill(dp, BigInteger.ZERO); dp[0] = BigInteger.ONE;
        for (int s = 0; s < shots; s++) {
            BigInteger[] next = new BigInteger[total + 1]; Arrays.fill(next, BigInteger.ZERO);
            for (int sum = 0; sum <= total; sum++) {
                for (int x = minimum; x <= maximum && x <= total - sum; x++) {
                    next[sum + x] = next[sum + x].add(dp[sum]);
                }
            }
            dp = next;
        }
        return dp[total];
    }
    /** Players are 0..n-1; counting begins at 0 with count 1. */
    public static int josephusSurvivor(int n, long step) {
        if (n < 1 || step < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("positive n and step");
        long winner = 0;
        for (long size = 2; size <= n; size++) winner = (winner + step % size) % size;
        return (int) winner;
    }
    /** Full elimination order, including the survivor as its final element. */
    public static List<Integer> josephusOrder(int n, long step) {
        if (n < 1 || step < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("positive n and step");
        Fenwick tree = new Fenwick(n); for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) tree.add(i, 1);
        List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>(); long rank = 0;
        for (int size = n; size > 0; size--) {
            rank = (rank + (step - 1) % size) % size;
            int position = tree.select((int) rank + 1);
            out.add(position - 1); tree.add(position, -1);
        }
        return out;
    }
    private static final class Fenwick {
        final int[] tree;
        Fenwick(int n) { if (n == Integer.MAX_VALUE) throw new IllegalArgumentException("array bound"); tree = new int[n + 1]; }
        void add(int i, int delta) {
            while (i < tree.length) {
                tree[i] += delta;
                long next = (long) i + (i & -i); if (next >= tree.length) break; i = (int) next;
            }
        }
        int select(int k) {
            int at = 0;
            for (int jump = Integer.highestOneBit(tree.length - 1); jump != 0; jump >>>= 1) {
                long next = (long) at + jump;
                if (next < tree.length && tree[(int) next] < k) { at = (int) next; k -= tree[at]; }
            }
            return at + 1;
        }
    }
    public static BigInteger minimumGoldCutCost(long[] pieces) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(pieces);
        PriorityQueue<BigInteger> heap = new PriorityQueue<>();
        for (long x : pieces) {
            if (x < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("negative length");
            heap.add(BigInteger.valueOf(x));
        }
        BigInteger total = BigInteger.ZERO;
        while (heap.size() > 1) {
            BigInteger merged = heap.remove().add(heap.remove()); total = total.add(merged); heap.add(merged);
        }
        return total;
    }
    public static String largestConcatenation(int[] values) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(values);
        if (values.length == 0) return "";
        String[] a = new String[values.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            if (values[i] < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("nonnegative integers");
            a[i] = Integer.toString(values[i]);
        }
        Arrays.sort(a, (x,y) -> (y + x).compareTo(x + y));
        return a[0].equals("0") ? "0" : String.join("", a);
    }
    /** Pick k digits, maintaining order within each input, and freely interleave the picks. */
    public static int[] largestNumberFromTwoArrays(int[] a, int[] b, int k) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(a); Objects.requireNonNull(b);
        for (int x : a) if (x < 0 || x > 9) throw new IllegalArgumentException("digits");
        for (int x : b) if (x < 0 || x > 9) throw new IllegalArgumentException("digits");
        if (k < 0 || k > (long) a.length + b.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("k");
        int[] best = null;
        for (int take = Math.max(0, k - b.length); take <= Math.min(k, a.length); take++) {
            int[] x = maximumSubsequence(a, take), y = maximumSubsequence(b, k - take), merged = new int[k];
            int i = 0, j = 0;
            for (int p = 0; p < k; p++) merged[p] = suffixAtLeast(x, i, y, j) ? x[i++] : y[j++];
            if (best == null || suffixAtLeast(merged, 0, best, 0)) best = merged;
        }
        return best;
    }
    private static int[] maximumSubsequence(int[] a, int k) {
        int[] stack = new int[k]; int size = 0, discard = a.length - k;
        for (int x : a) {
            while (size > 0 && discard > 0 && stack[size - 1] < x) { size--; discard--; }
            if (size < k) stack[size++] = x; else discard--;
        }
        return stack;
    }
    private static boolean suffixAtLeast(int[] a, int i, int[] b, int j) {
        while (i < a.length && j < b.length && a[i] == b[j]) { i++; j++; }
        return j == b.length || (i < a.length && a[i] > b[j]);
    }
}

    static void perm(int[] a, boolean[] used, List<Integer> path, List<List<Integer>> out) {
        if (path.size()==a.length) { out.add(List.copyOf(path)); return; }
        for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++) if(!used[i]) {used[i]=true;path.add(a[i]);perm(a,used,path,out);path.remove(path.size()-1);used[i]=false;}

    static long shot(int left,int total,int low,int high) { if(left==0)return total==0?1:0; if(total<0)return 0;long count=0;for(int x=low;x<=high;x++)count+=shot(left-1,total-x,low,high);return count; }
    static BigInteger gold(List<BigInteger> a,Map<String,BigInteger> memo) {
        if(a.size()<2)return BigInteger.ZERO;
        List<BigInteger> sorted=new ArrayList<>(a);Collections.sort(sorted);String key=sorted.toString();
        if(memo.containsKey(key))return memo.get(key);
        BigInteger best=null;
        for(int i=0;i<a.size();i++)for(int j=i+1;j<a.size();j++) {
            List<BigInteger> next=new ArrayList<>();for(int p=0;p<a.size();p++)if(p!=i&&p!=j)next.add(a.get(p));
            BigInteger sum=a.get(i).add(a.get(j));next.add(sum);BigInteger cost=sum.add(gold(next,memo));if(best==null||cost.compareTo(best)<0)best=cost;
        }
        memo.put(key,best);return best;
    }
    static String create(int[] a,int i,int[] b,int j,int k,Map<String,String> memo) {
        if(k==0)return "";if(a.length-i+b.length-j<k)return null;
        String key=i+":"+j+":"+k;if(memo.containsKey(key))return memo.get(key);String best=null;
        for(int p=i;p<a.length;p++){String tail=create(a,p+1,b,j,k-1,memo);if(tail!=null){String s=a[p]+tail;if(best==null||s.compareTo(best)>0)best=s;}}
        for(int p=j;p<b.length;p++){String tail=create(a,i,b,p+1,k-1,memo);if(tail!=null){String s=b[p]+tail;if(best==null||s.compareTo(best)>0)best=s;}}
        memo.put(key,best);return best;
    }
    static String concat(int[] a,boolean[] used,StringBuilder path) {
        int count=0;for(boolean x:used)if(x)count++;if(count==a.length)return path.toString();String best="";
        for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(!used[i]){int old=path.length();path.append(a[i]);used[i]=true;String s=concat(a,used,path);if(s.compareTo(best)>0)best=s;used[i]=false;path.setLength(old);}return best;
    }
}

随机源方向、红包分配、取整与梯度下降

随机分红包，需要先说哪一种公平

若总金额为整数分、每人至少一分，并希望所有有序正整数分配方案等概率，可以从 1 到 M-1 中均匀选 N-1 个不同切点，排序后取相邻差。

M 是总分数，N 是人数。把切点排好后，相邻差就是每个人的金额；反过来，把一份有序正整数分配逐项累加，也能还原那组切点。因此两者一一对应，均匀选切点集合就得到均匀分配方案。

这里的公平指方案等概率：所有人的期望金额相同，但每个人的各种可能金额并不等概率，也不同于常见的“二倍均值”业务规则。最小/最大红包、尾包限制、展示公平和防作弊若另有要求，都应先明确，不能只用“随机”概括。

实现使用稀疏 Fisher–Yates 选切点，不分配长度 M 的数组；M 可为 long。选点期望 O(N) 次哈希操作，排序 O(N log N)，空间 O(N)。每个红包为正，精确加总等于 M，不用 double 存钱。N=1 不调用随机源，M<N 直接拒绝。参数 uniformBelow(bound) 必须对 [0,bound) 独立均匀采样；测试可注入固定序列，实际有对抗需求时应使用合适的密码学随机源与服务端审计，不能把可预测伪随机种子当成防作弊措施。

每项向上或向下取整，使总和等于目标且变化最小

先把全部元素向下取整，再把小数部分最大的若干项改成向上取整即可。

这里的目标整数，是全部取整结果的总和；代价是各项绝对变化之和。先设全部 floor 的和为 F，目标为 T：每把一个非整数项从 floor 换成 ceil，总和就增加一，因此需要恰好 T-F 项改用 ceil。

原本为整数的项没有两个不同选项，不能拿来增加总和。若需要提升的数量不在 0 到非整数项个数之间，就无解。

某项小数部分为 f，向下的代价为 f，向上的代价为 1-f，改选向上的增量代价就是 1-2f，所以按 f 从大到小选最优。负数也成立，例如 -1.2 的 floor 是 -2，小数部分为 0.8；不能用截断到零替代 floor。相同小数部分按原下标决定，输出稳定。

BigDecimal 版本计算十进制精确代价与 BigInteger 目标；double 包装明确按每个有限 double 的规范十进制表示建模，不宣称等于对原二进制分数做任意精度解析。若题目所谓“变化”是平方误差、相对误差或最大误差，交换论证要重新验证；如果目标整数不是总和，必须另行澄清。排序时间 O(n log n)，空间 O(n)，数值运算成本另计。

import java.math.*;

import java.util.function.LongUnaryOperator;

public final class RandomAndRounding {
    private RandomAndRounding() {}
    /** Supplied draws must be independent and uniform on 1..7. Output is uniform on 1..10. */
    public static int rand7To10(IntSupplier source){Objects.requireNonNull(source);for(;;){int a=source.getAsInt(),b=source.getAsInt();if(a<1||a>7||b<1||b>7)throw new IllegalArgumentException("rand7 range");int x=(a-1)*7+b-1;if(x<40)return x%10+1;}}
    /** IID source: P(0)=p, P(1)=1-p, with fixed unknown 0<p<1. */

    private static long below(LongUnaryOperator source,long bound){long value=source.applyAsLong(bound);if(value<0||value>=bound)throw new IllegalArgumentException("random result outside bound");return value;}
    /** Uniform over ORDERED positive-integer compositions, not a double-mean business rule. */
    public static long[] splitRedPackets(long totalFen,int people,LongUnaryOperator uniformBelow){
        Objects.requireNonNull(uniformBelow);if(people<1||totalFen<people)throw new IllegalArgumentException("each person needs at least one fen");
        long[] cuts=new long[people-1];Map<Long,Long> swaps=new HashMap<>();long population=totalFen-1;
        for(int i=0;i<cuts.length;i++){long remaining=population-i,index=below(uniformBelow,remaining),last=remaining-1;long chosen=swaps.getOrDefault(index,index),replacement=swaps.getOrDefault(last,last);if(index!=last)swaps.put(index,replacement);swaps.remove(last);cuts[i]=chosen+1;}
        Arrays.sort(cuts);long[] result=new long[people];long previous=0;for(int i=0;i<cuts.length;i++){result[i]=cuts[i]-previous;previous=cuts[i];}result[people-1]=totalFen-previous;return result;
    }
    public record Rounded(List<BigInteger> values,BigDecimal absoluteChange){public Rounded{values=List.copyOf(values);}}
    private record Fraction(int index,BigDecimal value) {}
    /** Each result is floor/ceil of its input, their sum equals target; minimize sum(abs(change)). */
    public static Optional<Rounded> roundToTarget(List<BigDecimal> input,BigInteger target){
        Objects.requireNonNull(input);Objects.requireNonNull(target);List<BigInteger> floors=new ArrayList<>();List<Fraction> fractions=new ArrayList<>();BigInteger total=BigInteger.ZERO;BigDecimal cost=BigDecimal.ZERO;int index=0;
        for(BigDecimal x:input){Objects.requireNonNull(x);BigInteger floor=x.setScale(0,RoundingMode.FLOOR).toBigIntegerExact();BigDecimal fraction=x.subtract(new BigDecimal(floor));floors.add(floor);total=total.add(floor);cost=cost.add(fraction);if(fraction.signum()!=0)fractions.add(new Fraction(index,fraction));index++;}
        BigInteger need=target.subtract(total);if(need.signum()<0||need.compareTo(BigInteger.valueOf(fractions.size()))>0)return Optional.empty();
        fractions.sort(Comparator.comparing(Fraction::value).reversed().thenComparingInt(Fraction::index));int count=need.intValueExact();
        for(int i=0;i<count;i++){Fraction f=fractions.get(i);floors.set(f.index,floors.get(f.index).add(BigInteger.ONE));cost=cost.add(BigDecimal.ONE.subtract(f.value.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(2))));}
        return Optional.of(new Rounded(floors,cost));
    }
    /** Uses the canonical decimal spelling of each finite double, not its exact binary fraction. */
    public static Optional<Rounded> roundFiniteDoubles(double[] input,BigInteger target){Objects.requireNonNull(input);List<BigDecimal> decimal=new ArrayList<>();for(double x:input){if(!Double.isFinite(x))throw new IllegalArgumentException("finite inputs");decimal.add(BigDecimal.valueOf(x));}return roundToTarget(decimal,target);}
    public record RootApproximation(double value,double normalizedResidual,int iterations,boolean converged) {}
    /** Gradient descent on scaled loss 1/2*(y*y-q)^2; no sqrt/Newton step. */
    public static RootApproximation squareRootGradient(double x,double tolerance,int maximumIterations){
        if(!Double.isFinite(x)||x<0||!Double.isFinite(tolerance)||tolerance<=0||tolerance>=1||maximumIterations<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("root parameters");if(x==0)return new RootApproximation(0,0,0,true);
        int exponent=Math.getExponent(x);if(exponent==Double.MIN_EXPONENT-1){exponent=Math.getExponent(Math.scalb(x,54))-54;}
        int half=Math.floorDiv(exponent,2);double q=Math.scalb(x,-2*half),y=1.0; // q in [1,4), y remains in [1,2]
        for(int i=0;i<=maximumIterations;i++){
            double residual=Math.abs(y*y-q)/q;if(residual<=tolerance)return new RootApproximation(Math.scalb(y,half),residual,i,true);
            if(i==maximumIterations)return new RootApproximation(Math.scalb(y,half),residual,i,false);
            double gradient=2*y*(y*y-q);y-=gradient/64.0;
        }
        throw new AssertionError();
    }
}

三次重复中的单个数、紧凑标签与整数几何

位运算题把每一位当成独立的小状态机，几何题则尽量保留整数关系，避免浮点斜率和先溢出再转大整数。

完整实现

示例代码（尚未验证运行结果）
import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.util.*;

public final class BitGeometryVariants {
    private BitGeometryVariants() {}
    /** One value occurs once, every other value exactly three times. No full frequency validation. */
    public static int singleAmongTriples(int[] a){Objects.requireNonNull(a);if(a.length==0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("nonempty");int answer=0;for(int bit=0;bit<32;bit++){int remainder=0;for(int x:a)remainder=(remainder+((x>>>bit)&1))%3;if(remainder!=0)answer|=1<<bit;}return answer;}
    public static int singleAmongTriplesStateMachine(int[] a){Objects.requireNonNull(a);if(a.length==0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("nonempty");int ones=0,twos=0;for(int x:a){ones=(ones^x)&~twos;twos=(twos^x)&~ones;}return ones;}
    /** Two tags 0..15, four tags 0..200, final tag 100..20000. */
    public static long packTags(int[] tags){
        Objects.requireNonNull(tags);if(tags.length!=7)throw new IllegalArgumentException("seven tags");
        if(tags[0]<0||tags[0]>15||tags[1]<0||tags[1]>15||tags[6]<100||tags[6]>20000)throw new IllegalArgumentException("tag range");
        long packed=tags[0]|((long)tags[1]<<4);
        for(int i=2;i<6;i++){if(tags[i]<0||tags[i]>200)throw new IllegalArgumentException("tag range");packed|=(long)tags[i]<<(8+8*(i-2));}
        return packed|((long)(tags[6]-100)<<40);
    }
    public static int[] unpackTags(long packed){
        if(packed<0||(packed>>>55)!=0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("packed range");int[] a=new int[7];a[0]=(int)(packed&15);a[1]=(int)((packed>>>4)&15);for(int i=2;i<6;i++)a[i]=(int)((packed>>>(8+8*(i-2)))&255);a[6]=(int)((packed>>>40)&32767)+100;packTags(a);return a;
    }
    /** Numeric order groups by final tag first, then by the remaining packed fields. */
    public static long[] uniqueTagsSortedByLast(int[][] records){
        Objects.requireNonNull(records);long[] packed=new long[records.length];for(int i=0;i<records.length;i++)packed[i]=packTags(records[i]);Arrays.sort(packed);int size=0;for(long value:packed)if(size==0||value!=packed[size-1])packed[size++]=value;return Arrays.copyOf(packed,size);
    }
    public record Point(int x,int y) {}
    private record Slope(long dy,long dx) {}
    /** All points counted, including repeated coordinates; collinearity without floating slopes. */
    public static int maximumCollinear(List<Point> supplied){
        Objects.requireNonNull(supplied);List<Point> points=new ArrayList<>(supplied);for(Point p:points)Objects.requireNonNull(p);int best=0;
        for(int i=0;i<points.size();i++){Map<Slope,Integer> count=new HashMap<>();int duplicates=0,sameSlope=0;Point a=points.get(i);
            for(int j=i+1;j<points.size();j++){Point b=points.get(j);long dx=(long)b.x-a.x,dy=(long)b.y-a.y;if(dx==0&&dy==0){duplicates++;continue;}long gcd=gcd(Math.abs(dx),Math.abs(dy));dx/=gcd;dy/=gcd;if(dx<0||(dx==0&&dy<0)){dx=-dx;dy=-dy;}int n=count.merge(new Slope(dy,dx),1,Integer::sum);sameSlope=Math.max(sameSlope,n);}
            best=Math.max(best,1+duplicates+sameSlope);
        }return best;

import java.math.BigInteger;

public final class InterfaceAlgorithms {
    private InterfaceAlgorithms() {}
    public record Log(int function, boolean start, long timestamp) {
        public Log { if (function < 0 || timestamp < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("nonnegative id/time"); }
        public static Log parse(String line) {
            Objects.requireNonNull(line); String[] p = line.split(":", -1);
            if (p.length != 3 || !(p[1].equals("start") || p[1].equals("end"))) throw new IllegalArgumentException("id:start|end:time");
            if (!digits(p[0]) || !digits(p[2])) throw new IllegalArgumentException("decimal id/time");
            try { return new Log(Integer.parseInt(p[0]), p[1].equals("start"), Long.parseLong(p[2])); }
            catch (NumberFormatException ex) { throw new IllegalArgumentException("id/time range", ex); }
        }
        private static boolean digits(String s) { if (s.isEmpty()) return false; for (int i=0;i<s.length();i++) if (s.charAt(i)<'0'||s.charAt(i)>'9') return false; return true; }
    }
    /** Single thread; start at beginning of tick, end at end of tick; recursion allowed. */
    public static BigInteger[] exclusiveTimes(int functions, List<Log> logs) {
        if (functions < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("function count"); Objects.requireNonNull(logs);
        BigInteger[] total = new BigInteger[functions]; Arrays.fill(total, BigInteger.ZERO);
        Deque<Integer> active = new ArrayDeque<>(); BigInteger cursor = BigInteger.ZERO; long last = -1;

            last = event.timestamp; BigInteger time = BigInteger.valueOf(event.timestamp);

    public static int p99NearestRank(int[] samples) {

数值二分、计数与构造：先确定精度和顺序

整数立方根向下取整

在满足 x³ <= n 的整数里二分最大 x，就能得到包含负数在内的向下取整立方根。

-9 的答案是 -3；先算正数根再直接取负会得到 -2，这不是向下取整。

对 long 输入，答案必在 [-2097152,2097152] 内。实现用 BigInteger 比较立方，避免中间乘法溢出；二分始终保持左端可行、右端不可行的开区间，直到只剩一个整数。固定 64 位输入只需约 23 次比较；推广到任意位宽时还要计算大整数乘法成本，不能称为任意精度 O(1)。

整数平方根，保留三位小数

把被开方数乘以 10⁶，先求精确整数平方根，再按明确的舍入规则格式化为三位小数。

先确认“保留三位”是截断还是四舍五入。接口显式区分两者，拒绝负输入，不用浮点 epsilon 猜边界。

四舍五入也能用整数判断：若缩放后的整数根为 q，比较 4N 与 (2q+1)²，就知道真值是否达到 q+0.5。sqrt(2) 得到 1.414，完全平方数也保留尾部零。计算精度由整数运算保证；测试可用更高精度 BigDecimal.sqrt 作独立数值对照。

1 到 n 中字典序第 k 小的整数

把十进制数字看成隐式前缀树，先计算当前前缀整棵子树包含多少数，再决定跳到下一个兄弟还是进入第一个孩子。

计数时，把前缀区间每下一层乘以 10，再与 [1,n] 取交集；这样就不用生成 n 个字符串。k 从 1 开始，进入孩子时要减去当前前缀自己，不能把它漏算。

对 int 上界，计数和前缀扩展使用 long。时间 O(log² n)，空间 O(1)。若允许前导零、包含 0 或负数，排序域已经变化，需要重新确定计数约定。

n 个不同数的第 m 个全排列

按值排序后，每个首元素下都有 (n-1)! 个排列，用 m 所在的阶乘分组逐位确定元素。

实现把 m 当作一基排名，所以先减一，再求商和余数。输入元素必须不同，按整数大小排序；空输入也有一个空排列。阶乘和排名使用 BigInteger，避免 n! 很快溢出 long。

候选容器会影响成本：ArrayList 删除第 i 个候选是 O(n)，因此除大整数运算外，总时间 O(n²)；改用顺序统计树，可把选取部分降到 O(n log n)。如果数字有重复，就要改用多重集合排列计数，不能继续让每组都乘相同阶乘。

0 到 8 的圆环，走 n 步回到 0

令 dp[位置] 表示走完当前步数后的路径数量，每一轮从左右相邻位置转移，初始只有 dp[0]=1。

圆环有 9 个位置，取模分别是 (p+8)%9 与 (p+1)%9。顺时针、逆时针的选择序列不同，就算不同方案；n=0 时“不走”是一种方案。必须使用新数组，避免同一轮刚更新的值被再次使用。BigInteger 防止方案数溢出，执行 O(9n) 次加法，保留 9 个计数；这些计数的位长随 n 增长，所以位空间并不是与 n 无关。

十枪打出八十环，有多少种情况？

确认每枪允许的环数与是否区分射击顺序后，用“已经打了几枪、累计环数”的计数 DP。

题目只给“10 枪、80 环”还不足以确定答案：脱靶 0 环算不算，最低是否 1 环，交换两枪是否是同一种，都影响结果。代码接收每枪最小、最大环数，统计有序射击序列；调用 shotScoreWays(10,80,0,10) 或 (10,80,1,10) 对应两种明确模型。0 枪凑出 0 环为 1 种。直接转移时间 O(枪数×目标环数×环数范围)，空间 O(目标环数)，均另计大整数位成本；更大分值范围可用滑动窗口求和优化每轮转移。

约瑟夫环，求最后一人还是完整出圈顺序？

只求幸存者时使用 f(n)=(f(n-1)+m)%n；要打印完整淘汰顺序，则额外维护动态存活位置。

这里人员编号 0 到 n-1，从 0 开始报 1，每报到 m 淘汰当前人，下一个存活者重新报 1。m=1 时按编号顺序淘汰，最后是 n-1。递推只存一个下标，O(n) 时间、O(1) 空间。先做 m % size 再相加，避免很大的 long m 溢出。

完整顺序用树状数组记录每个原位置是否存活，通过二进制提升查找第 k 个存活者，每次 O(log n)，总 O(n log n)，空间 O(n)，返回列表最后一个人就是幸存者。若只用 ArrayList 模拟删除，代码更短，但最坏 O(n²)，面试时要把这个成本说出来。

分割金条的最小花费

若每次分割的花费等于当前被切金条长度，倒过来看就是每次合并两段的花费等于两段长度和；始终合并最短两段最优。

这是最优合并/Huffman 的交换论证：最小的两个权重可以安排在最深的兄弟叶子上，合并后缩成一个子问题。最小堆重复取两项、合并、放回，时间 O(n log n)、堆空间 O(n)，另计大整数操作。空集合与一段金条都不需要切割，花费为 0；长度必须非负。若切割花费有固定启动费、位置限制或不能自由重排，需重新建模。

“拼接出最大的数”至少有两种不同约定

若使用全部非负整数并可任意换序，按 a+b 与 b+a 的字典序决定两项先后；若从两个数字数组选 k 位并保留各自内部次序，则要枚举两边取多少位，再合并最优子序列。

第一种是 [3,30,34,5,9]→9534330，拼接比较不把整个结果转成数值，避免溢出。所有项为 0 时输出一个 0，空输入返回空串。对固定 int 输入，比较的字符串长度有固定上限，排序 O(n log n)；一般任意长字符串要乘比较字符成本。

第二种先用单调栈，分别找出每个数组在指定长度下的最大子序列。合并时不能只比较当前一位，而要比较两个剩余后缀。例如当前都为 6，下一位仍可能决定从哪边取。

枚举可行拆分数为 S，当前直接后缀比较实现的时间上界为 O(S(m+n+k²))，空间 O(m+n+k) 的宽松上界，工作子序列与答案实际为 O(k)。这个直接实现不能承诺 O(m+n)。下面保留两种题意的完整代码，先确认是否允许重排，再选对应接口。

import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.util.*;

public final class NumericVariants {
    private NumericVariants() {}
    public static long floorCubeRoot(long n) {
        long l = -2_097_152, r = 2_097_153;
        BigInteger value = BigInteger.valueOf(n);
        while (l + 1 < r) {
            long m = l + (r - l) / 2;
            if (BigInteger.valueOf(m).pow(3).compareTo(value) <= 0) l = m;
            else r = m;
        }
        return l;
    }
    /** Nonnegative input; halfUp=false truncates, true rounds halfway upward. */
    public static String squareRootThreeDecimals(long n, boolean halfUp) {
        if (n < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("nonnegative radicand");
        BigInteger scaled = BigInteger.valueOf(n).multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(1_000_000));
        BigInteger l = BigInteger.ZERO, r = BigInteger.ONE.shiftLeft((scaled.bitLength() + 1) / 2 + 1);
        while (l.add(BigInteger.ONE).compareTo(r) < 0) {
            BigInteger m = l.add(r).shiftRight(1);
            if (m.multiply(m).compareTo(scaled) <= 0) l = m; else r = m;
        }
        if (halfUp && scaled.shiftLeft(2).compareTo(l.shiftLeft(1).add(BigInteger.ONE).pow(2)) >= 0)
            l = l.add(BigInteger.ONE);
        BigInteger[] pieces = l.divideAndRemainder(BigInteger.valueOf(1000));
        return pieces[0] + "." + String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%03d", pieces[1].intValueExact());
    }
    public static int kthLexicographicalNumber(int n, int k) {
        if (n < 1 || k < 1 || k > n) throw new IllegalArgumentException("1 <= k <= n");
        long prefix = 1; int remaining = k - 1;
        while (remaining > 0) {
            long count = 0, first = prefix, next = prefix + 1;
            while (first <= n) {
                count += Math.min((long) n + 1, next) - first;
                first *= 10; next *= 10;
            }
            if (count <= remaining) { remaining -= (int) count; prefix++; }
            else { prefix *= 10; remaining--; }
        }
        return (int) prefix;
    }
    /** Lexicographic order by integer value. Input values must be distinct. Rank is 1-based. */
    public static List<Integer> kthPermutation(int[] values, BigInteger rank) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(values); Objects.requireNonNull(rank);
        int[] sorted = values.clone(); Arrays.sort(sorted);
        List<Integer> unused = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
            if (i > 0 && sorted[i] == sorted[i - 1]) throw new IllegalArgumentException("distinct values required");
            unused.add(sorted[i]);
        }
        BigInteger[] factorial = new BigInteger[values.length + 1]; factorial[0] = BigInteger.ONE;
        for (int i = 1; i <= values.length; i++) factorial[i] = factorial[i - 1].multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(i));
        if (rank.signum() <= 0 || rank.compareTo(factorial[values.length]) > 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("rank out of range");
        BigInteger r = rank.subtract(BigInteger.ONE);
        List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int left = values.length; left > 0; left--) {
            BigInteger[] division = r.divideAndRemainder(factorial[left - 1]);
            out.add(unused.remove(division[0].intValueExact())); r = division[1];
        }
        return out;
    }
    /** Ring positions 0..8; each step chooses one of two directions. */
    public static BigInteger ringNineReturnWays(int steps) {
        if (steps < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("negative steps");
        BigInteger[] dp = new BigInteger[9]; Arrays.fill(dp, BigInteger.ZERO); dp[0] = BigInteger.ONE;
        for (int s = 0; s < steps; s++) {
            BigInteger[] next = new BigInteger[9];
            for (int p = 0; p < 9; p++) next[p] = dp[(p + 8) % 9].add(dp[(p + 1) % 9]);
            dp = next;
        }
        return dp[0];
    }
    /** Ordered shot outcomes; every score in [minimum,maximum] is available each time. */
    public static BigInteger shotScoreWays(int shots, int total, int minimum, int maximum) {
        if (shots < 0 || total < 0 || minimum < 0 || maximum < minimum || total == Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid bounds");
        if ((long) shots * minimum > total || (long) shots * maximum < total) return BigInteger.ZERO;
        BigInteger[] dp = new BigInteger[total + 1]; Arrays.fill(dp, BigInteger.ZERO); dp[0] = BigInteger.ONE;
        for (int s = 0; s < shots; s++) {
            BigInteger[] next = new BigInteger[total + 1]; Arrays.fill(next, BigInteger.ZERO);
            for (int sum = 0; sum <= total; sum++) {
                for (int x = minimum; x <= maximum && x <= total - sum; x++) {
                    next[sum + x] = next[sum + x].add(dp[sum]);
                }
            }
            dp = next;
        }
        return dp[total];
    }
    /** Players are 0..n-1; counting begins at 0 with count 1. */
    public static int josephusSurvivor(int n, long step) {
        if (n < 1 || step < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("positive n and step");
        long winner = 0;
        for (long size = 2; size <= n; size++) winner = (winner + step % size) % size;
        return (int) winner;
    }
    /** Full elimination order, including the survivor as its final element. */
    public static List<Integer> josephusOrder(int n, long step) {
        if (n < 1 || step < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("positive n and step");
        Fenwick tree = new Fenwick(n); for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) tree.add(i, 1);
        List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>(); long rank = 0;
        for (int size = n; size > 0; size--) {
            rank = (rank + (step - 1) % size) % size;
            int position = tree.select((int) rank + 1);
            out.add(position - 1); tree.add(position, -1);
        }
        return out;
    }
    private static final class Fenwick {
        final int[] tree;
        Fenwick(int n) { if (n == Integer.MAX_VALUE) throw new IllegalArgumentException("array bound"); tree = new int[n + 1]; }
        void add(int i, int delta) {
            while (i < tree.length) {
                tree[i] += delta;
                long next = (long) i + (i & -i); if (next >= tree.length) break; i = (int) next;
            }
        }
        int select(int k) {
            int at = 0;
            for (int jump = Integer.highestOneBit(tree.length - 1); jump != 0; jump >>>= 1) {
                long next = (long) at + jump;
                if (next < tree.length && tree[(int) next] < k) { at = (int) next; k -= tree[at]; }
            }
            return at + 1;
        }
    }
    public static BigInteger minimumGoldCutCost(long[] pieces) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(pieces);
        PriorityQueue<BigInteger> heap = new PriorityQueue<>();
        for (long x : pieces) {
            if (x < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("negative length");
            heap.add(BigInteger.valueOf(x));
        }
        BigInteger total = BigInteger.ZERO;
        while (heap.size() > 1) {
            BigInteger merged = heap.remove().add(heap.remove()); total = total.add(merged); heap.add(merged);
        }
        return total;
    }
    public static String largestConcatenation(int[] values) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(values);
        if (values.length == 0) return "";
        String[] a = new String[values.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            if (values[i] < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("nonnegative integers");
            a[i] = Integer.toString(values[i]);
        }
        Arrays.sort(a, (x,y) -> (y + x).compareTo(x + y));
        return a[0].equals("0") ? "0" : String.join("", a);
    }
    /** Pick k digits, maintaining order within each input, and freely interleave the picks. */
    public static int[] largestNumberFromTwoArrays(int[] a, int[] b, int k) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(a); Objects.requireNonNull(b);
        for (int x : a) if (x < 0 || x > 9) throw new IllegalArgumentException("digits");
        for (int x : b) if (x < 0 || x > 9) throw new IllegalArgumentException("digits");
        if (k < 0 || k > (long) a.length + b.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("k");
        int[] best = null;
        for (int take = Math.max(0, k - b.length); take <= Math.min(k, a.length); take++) {
            int[] x = maximumSubsequence(a, take), y = maximumSubsequence(b, k - take), merged = new int[k];
            int i = 0, j = 0;
            for (int p = 0; p < k; p++) merged[p] = suffixAtLeast(x, i, y, j) ? x[i++] : y[j++];
            if (best == null || suffixAtLeast(merged, 0, best, 0)) best = merged;
        }
        return best;
    }
    private static int[] maximumSubsequence(int[] a, int k) {
        int[] stack = new int[k]; int size = 0, discard = a.length - k;
        for (int x : a) {
            while (size > 0 && discard > 0 && stack[size - 1] < x) { size--; discard--; }
            if (size < k) stack[size++] = x; else discard--;
        }
        return stack;
    }
    private static boolean suffixAtLeast(int[] a, int i, int[] b, int j) {
        while (i < a.length && j < b.length && a[i] == b[j]) { i++; j++; }
        return j == b.length || (i < a.length && a[i] > b[j]);
    }
}

    static void cube(long n) {
        long q = NumericVariants.floorCubeRoot(n); BigInteger value = BigInteger.valueOf(n);
        eq(BigInteger.valueOf(q).pow(3).compareTo(value) <= 0,true);
        eq(BigInteger.valueOf(q+1).pow(3).compareTo(value) > 0,true);
    }
    static void perm(int[] a, boolean[] used, List<Integer> path, List<List<Integer>> out) {
        if (path.size()==a.length) { out.add(List.copyOf(path)); return; }
        for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++) if(!used[i]) {used[i]=true;path.add(a[i]);perm(a,used,path,out);path.remove(path.size()-1);used[i]=false;}
    }
    static long shot(int left,int total,int low,int high) { if(left==0)return total==0?1:0; if(total<0)return 0;long count=0;for(int x=low;x<=high;x++)count+=shot(left-1,total-x,low,high);return count; }
    static BigInteger gold(List<BigInteger> a,Map<String,BigInteger> memo) {
        if(a.size()<2)return BigInteger.ZERO;
        List<BigInteger> sorted=new ArrayList<>(a);Collections.sort(sorted);String key=sorted.toString();
        if(memo.containsKey(key))return memo.get(key);
        BigInteger best=null;
        for(int i=0;i<a.size();i++)for(int j=i+1;j<a.size();j++) {
            List<BigInteger> next=new ArrayList<>();for(int p=0;p<a.size();p++)if(p!=i&&p!=j)next.add(a.get(p));
            BigInteger sum=a.get(i).add(a.get(j));next.add(sum);BigInteger cost=sum.add(gold(next,memo));if(best==null||cost.compareTo(best)<0)best=cost;
        }
        memo.put(key,best);return best;
    }
    static String create(int[] a,int i,int[] b,int j,int k,Map<String,String> memo) {
        if(k==0)return "";if(a.length-i+b.length-j<k)return null;
        String key=i+":"+j+":"+k;if(memo.containsKey(key))return memo.get(key);String best=null;
        for(int p=i;p<a.length;p++){String tail=create(a,p+1,b,j,k-1,memo);if(tail!=null){String s=a[p]+tail;if(best==null||s.compareTo(best)>0)best=s;}}
        for(int p=j;p<b.length;p++){String tail=create(a,i,b,p+1,k-1,memo);if(tail!=null){String s=b[p]+tail;if(best==null||s.compareTo(best)>0)best=s;}}
        memo.put(key,best);return best;
    }
    static String concat(int[] a,boolean[] used,StringBuilder path) {
        int count=0;for(boolean x:used)if(x)count++;if(count==a.length)return path.toString();String best="";
        for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(!used[i]){int old=path.length();path.append(a[i]);used[i]=true;String s=concat(a,used,path);if(s.compareTo(best)>0)best=s;used[i]=false;path.setLength(old);}return best;
    }
}

随机源方向、红包分配、取整与梯度下降

随机分红包，需要先说哪一种公平

若总金额为整数分、每人至少一分，并希望所有有序正整数分配方案等概率，可以从 1 到 M-1 中均匀选 N-1 个不同切点，排序后取相邻差。

M 是总分数，N 是人数。把切点排好后，相邻差就是每个人的金额；反过来，把一份有序正整数分配逐项累加，也能还原那组切点。因此两者一一对应，均匀选切点集合就得到均匀分配方案。

这里的公平指方案等概率：所有人的期望金额相同，但每个人的各种可能金额并不等概率，也不同于常见的“二倍均值”业务规则。最小/最大红包、尾包限制、展示公平和防作弊若另有要求，都应先明确，不能只用“随机”概括。

实现使用稀疏 Fisher–Yates 选切点，不分配长度 M 的数组；M 可为 long。选点期望 O(N) 次哈希操作，排序 O(N log N)，空间 O(N)。每个红包为正，精确加总等于 M，不用 double 存钱。N=1 不调用随机源，M<N 直接拒绝。参数 uniformBelow(bound) 必须对 [0,bound) 独立均匀采样；测试可注入固定序列，实际有对抗需求时应使用合适的密码学随机源与服务端审计，不能把可预测伪随机种子当成防作弊措施。

每项向上或向下取整，使总和等于目标且变化最小

先把全部元素向下取整，再把小数部分最大的若干项改成向上取整即可。

这里的目标整数，是全部取整结果的总和；代价是各项绝对变化之和。先设全部 floor 的和为 F，目标为 T：每把一个非整数项从 floor 换成 ceil，总和就增加一，因此需要恰好 T-F 项改用 ceil。

原本为整数的项没有两个不同选项，不能拿来增加总和。若需要提升的数量不在 0 到非整数项个数之间，就无解。

某项小数部分为 f，向下的代价为 f，向上的代价为 1-f，改选向上的增量代价就是 1-2f，所以按 f 从大到小选最优。负数也成立，例如 -1.2 的 floor 是 -2，小数部分为 0.8；不能用截断到零替代 floor。相同小数部分按原下标决定，输出稳定。

BigDecimal 版本计算十进制精确代价与 BigInteger 目标；double 包装明确按每个有限 double 的规范十进制表示建模，不宣称等于对原二进制分数做任意精度解析。若题目所谓“变化”是平方误差、相对误差或最大误差，交换论证要重新验证；如果目标整数不是总和，必须另行澄清。排序时间 O(n log n)，空间 O(n)，数值运算成本另计。

import java.math.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.IntSupplier;
import java.util.function.LongUnaryOperator;

public final class RandomAndRounding {
    private RandomAndRounding() {}
    /** Supplied draws must be independent and uniform on 1..7. Output is uniform on 1..10. */
    public static int rand7To10(IntSupplier source){Objects.requireNonNull(source);for(;;){int a=source.getAsInt(),b=source.getAsInt();if(a<1||a>7||b<1||b>7)throw new IllegalArgumentException("rand7 range");int x=(a-1)*7+b-1;if(x<40)return x%10+1;}}
    /** IID source: P(0)=p, P(1)=1-p, with fixed unknown 0<p<1. */
    public static int unbiasedBit(IntSupplier biased){Objects.requireNonNull(biased);for(;;){int a=biased.getAsInt(),b=biased.getAsInt();if((a!=0&&a!=1)||(b!=0&&b!=1))throw new IllegalArgumentException("bit source");if(a!=b)return a;}}
    private static long below(LongUnaryOperator source,long bound){long value=source.applyAsLong(bound);if(value<0||value>=bound)throw new IllegalArgumentException("random result outside bound");return value;}
    /** Uniform over ORDERED positive-integer compositions, not a double-mean business rule. */
    public static long[] splitRedPackets(long totalFen,int people,LongUnaryOperator uniformBelow){
        Objects.requireNonNull(uniformBelow);if(people<1||totalFen<people)throw new IllegalArgumentException("each person needs at least one fen");
        long[] cuts=new long[people-1];Map<Long,Long> swaps=new HashMap<>();long population=totalFen-1;
        for(int i=0;i<cuts.length;i++){long remaining=population-i,index=below(uniformBelow,remaining),last=remaining-1;long chosen=swaps.getOrDefault(index,index),replacement=swaps.getOrDefault(last,last);if(index!=last)swaps.put(index,replacement);swaps.remove(last);cuts[i]=chosen+1;}
        Arrays.sort(cuts);long[] result=new long[people];long previous=0;for(int i=0;i<cuts.length;i++){result[i]=cuts[i]-previous;previous=cuts[i];}result[people-1]=totalFen-previous;return result;
    }
    public record Rounded(List<BigInteger> values,BigDecimal absoluteChange){public Rounded{values=List.copyOf(values);}}
    private record Fraction(int index,BigDecimal value) {}
    /** Each result is floor/ceil of its input, their sum equals target; minimize sum(abs(change)). */
    public static Optional<Rounded> roundToTarget(List<BigDecimal> input,BigInteger target){
        Objects.requireNonNull(input);Objects.requireNonNull(target);List<BigInteger> floors=new ArrayList<>();List<Fraction> fractions=new ArrayList<>();BigInteger total=BigInteger.ZERO;BigDecimal cost=BigDecimal.ZERO;int index=0;
        for(BigDecimal x:input){Objects.requireNonNull(x);BigInteger floor=x.setScale(0,RoundingMode.FLOOR).toBigIntegerExact();BigDecimal fraction=x.subtract(new BigDecimal(floor));floors.add(floor);total=total.add(floor);cost=cost.add(fraction);if(fraction.signum()!=0)fractions.add(new Fraction(index,fraction));index++;}
        BigInteger need=target.subtract(total);if(need.signum()<0||need.compareTo(BigInteger.valueOf(fractions.size()))>0)return Optional.empty();
        fractions.sort(Comparator.comparing(Fraction::value).reversed().thenComparingInt(Fraction::index));int count=need.intValueExact();
        for(int i=0;i<count;i++){Fraction f=fractions.get(i);floors.set(f.index,floors.get(f.index).add(BigInteger.ONE));cost=cost.add(BigDecimal.ONE.subtract(f.value.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(2))));}
        return Optional.of(new Rounded(floors,cost));
    }
    /** Uses the canonical decimal spelling of each finite double, not its exact binary fraction. */
    public static Optional<Rounded> roundFiniteDoubles(double[] input,BigInteger target){Objects.requireNonNull(input);List<BigDecimal> decimal=new ArrayList<>();for(double x:input){if(!Double.isFinite(x))throw new IllegalArgumentException("finite inputs");decimal.add(BigDecimal.valueOf(x));}return roundToTarget(decimal,target);}
    public record RootApproximation(double value,double normalizedResidual,int iterations,boolean converged) {}
    /** Gradient descent on scaled loss 1/2*(y*y-q)^2; no sqrt/Newton step. */
    public static RootApproximation squareRootGradient(double x,double tolerance,int maximumIterations){
        if(!Double.isFinite(x)||x<0||!Double.isFinite(tolerance)||tolerance<=0||tolerance>=1||maximumIterations<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("root parameters");if(x==0)return new RootApproximation(0,0,0,true);
        int exponent=Math.getExponent(x);if(exponent==Double.MIN_EXPONENT-1){exponent=Math.getExponent(Math.scalb(x,54))-54;}
        int half=Math.floorDiv(exponent,2);double q=Math.scalb(x,-2*half),y=1.0; // q in [1,4), y remains in [1,2]
        for(int i=0;i<=maximumIterations;i++){
            double residual=Math.abs(y*y-q)/q;if(residual<=tolerance)return new RootApproximation(Math.scalb(y,half),residual,i,true);
            if(i==maximumIterations)return new RootApproximation(Math.scalb(y,half),residual,i,false);
            double gradient=2*y*(y*y-q);y-=gradient/64.0;
        }
        throw new AssertionError();
    }
}

三次重复中的单个数、紧凑标签与整数几何

位运算题把每一位当成独立的小状态机，几何题则尽量保留整数关系，避免浮点斜率和先溢出再转大整数。

完整实现

示例代码（尚未验证运行结果）
import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.util.*;

public final class BitGeometryVariants {
    private BitGeometryVariants() {}
    /** One value occurs once, every other value exactly three times. No full frequency validation. */
    public static int singleAmongTriples(int[] a){Objects.requireNonNull(a);if(a.length==0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("nonempty");int answer=0;for(int bit=0;bit<32;bit++){int remainder=0;for(int x:a)remainder=(remainder+((x>>>bit)&1))%3;if(remainder!=0)answer|=1<<bit;}return answer;}
    public static int singleAmongTriplesStateMachine(int[] a){Objects.requireNonNull(a);if(a.length==0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("nonempty");int ones=0,twos=0;for(int x:a){ones=(ones^x)&~twos;twos=(twos^x)&~ones;}return ones;}
    /** Two tags 0..15, four tags 0..200, final tag 100..20000. */
    public static long packTags(int[] tags){
        Objects.requireNonNull(tags);if(tags.length!=7)throw new IllegalArgumentException("seven tags");
        if(tags[0]<0||tags[0]>15||tags[1]<0||tags[1]>15||tags[6]<100||tags[6]>20000)throw new IllegalArgumentException("tag range");
        long packed=tags[0]|((long)tags[1]<<4);
        for(int i=2;i<6;i++){if(tags[i]<0||tags[i]>200)throw new IllegalArgumentException("tag range");packed|=(long)tags[i]<<(8+8*(i-2));}
        return packed|((long)(tags[6]-100)<<40);
    }
    public static int[] unpackTags(long packed){
        if(packed<0||(packed>>>55)!=0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("packed range");int[] a=new int[7];a[0]=(int)(packed&15);a[1]=(int)((packed>>>4)&15);for(int i=2;i<6;i++)a[i]=(int)((packed>>>(8+8*(i-2)))&255);a[6]=(int)((packed>>>40)&32767)+100;packTags(a);return a;
    }
    /** Numeric order groups by final tag first, then by the remaining packed fields. */
    public static long[] uniqueTagsSortedByLast(int[][] records){
        Objects.requireNonNull(records);long[] packed=new long[records.length];for(int i=0;i<records.length;i++)packed[i]=packTags(records[i]);Arrays.sort(packed);int size=0;for(long value:packed)if(size==0||value!=packed[size-1])packed[size++]=value;return Arrays.copyOf(packed,size);
    }
    public record Point(int x,int y) {}
    private record Slope(long dy,long dx) {}
    /** All points counted, including repeated coordinates; collinearity without floating slopes. */
    public static int maximumCollinear(List<Point> supplied){
        Objects.requireNonNull(supplied);List<Point> points=new ArrayList<>(supplied);for(Point p:points)Objects.requireNonNull(p);int best=0;
        for(int i=0;i<points.size();i++){Map<Slope,Integer> count=new HashMap<>();int duplicates=0,sameSlope=0;Point a=points.get(i);
            for(int j=i+1;j<points.size();j++){Point b=points.get(j);long dx=(long)b.x-a.x,dy=(long)b.y-a.y;if(dx==0&&dy==0){duplicates++;continue;}long gcd=gcd(Math.abs(dx),Math.abs(dy));dx/=gcd;dy/=gcd;if(dx<0||(dx==0&&dy<0)){dx=-dx;dy=-dy;}int n=count.merge(new Slope(dy,dx),1,Integer::sum);sameSlope=Math.max(sameSlope,n);}
            best=Math.max(best,1+duplicates+sameSlope);
        }return best;
    }
    private static long gcd(long a,long b){while(b!=0){long t=a%b;a=b;b=t;}return a;}
    public record Rectangle(long left,long bottom,long right,long top){public Rectangle{if(left>right||bottom>top)throw new IllegalArgumentException("ordered rectangle bounds");}}
    public static BigInteger intersectionArea(Rectangle a,Rectangle b){
        Objects.requireNonNull(a);Objects.requireNonNull(b);long left=Math.max(a.left,b.left),right=Math.min(a.right,b.right),bottom=Math.max(a.bottom,b.bottom),top=Math.min(a.top,b.top);
        if(left>=right||bottom>=top)return BigInteger.ZERO;
        return BigInteger.valueOf(right).subtract(BigInteger.valueOf(left)).multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(top).subtract(BigInteger.valueOf(bottom)));
    }
    /** Four corners in arbitrary order, axis-aligned, distinct; degeneracy is rejected. */
    public static Rectangle fromFourCorners(long[][] points){
        Objects.requireNonNull(points);if(points.length!=4)throw new IllegalArgumentException("four corners");long left=Long.MAX_VALUE,right=Long.MIN_VALUE,bottom=Long.MAX_VALUE,top=Long.MIN_VALUE;
        for(long[] p:points){if(p==null||p.length!=2)throw new IllegalArgumentException("point");left=Math.min(left,p[0]);right=Math.max(right,p[0]);bottom=Math.min(bottom,p[1]);top=Math.max(top,p[1]);}
        if(left==right||bottom==top)throw new IllegalArgumentException("nondegenerate rectangle");boolean[] seen=new boolean[4];for(long[] p:points){if((p[0]!=left&&p[0]!=right)||(p[1]!=bottom&&p[1]!=top))throw new IllegalArgumentException("axis-aligned corners");int index=(p[0]==right?2:0)+(p[1]==top?1:0);if(seen[index])throw new IllegalArgumentException("duplicate corner");seen[index]=true;}return new Rectangle(left,bottom,right,top);
    }
    /** LC11: unit-spaced nonnegative heights; endpoints alone form container walls. */
    public static long maximumContainerArea(int[] height){Objects.requireNonNull(height);for(int h:height)if(h<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("nonnegative heights");int left=0,right=height.length-1;long best=0;while(left<right){best=Math.max(best,(long)(right-left)*Math.min(height[left],height[right]));if(height[left]<=height[right])left++;else right--;}return best;}
}

算法练习补充：快速幂：指数的二进制分解与负数边界

快速幂：指数的二进制分解与负数边界

把指数按二进制拆开，就能反复用平方跳过成批乘法。结果初值1，当前底数对应相应的2的幂次；最低位为1时把当前底数乘进结果，再将指数右移、底数平方。

每轮指数减半，共O(log(|n|+1))次循环、O(1)状态。负指数先将底数取倒数、指数取正；处理Integer.MIN_VALUE时，必须先转long再取负。

可能的问法

  • 怎样用 O(log |n|) 次乘法计算 m 的 n 次方？
  • 负指数、0、最小整数指数和浮点上下溢怎么处理？

输入、输出与前提

题目未给定数值类型时，需先确认。这里明确实现有限double底数和有符号int指数，允许负指数扩展；0的0次方按本API约定返回1，0的负次方拒绝。题目若只要求非负整数指数，核心循环相同；精确大整数/取模另有数值契约，不能混成同一复杂度承诺。

为什么这样做

若n为偶数，m^n=(m*m)^(n/2)；若n为奇数，m^n=m*(m*m)^((n-1)/2)。不必递归调用两次pow(m,n/2)，否则重复子问题又接近线性工作；保存一次半幂再平方，或迭代按位处理。

循环里始终保留同一个剩余任务：result*base^remaining等于目标幂。最低位为1时，先令result*=base，把一个base因子收进结果；随后remaining减半、base平方，剩余乘积不变。最低位为0就不改result，直接把成对因子合并。

remaining最终为0，剩余因子为1，result便是答案。这个证明使用精确实数代数；double执行时仍会舍入。

例如3^13，13二进制1101：初始result1/base3/remaining13，取最低位得result3；平方base9、剩6；6偶数不乘，平方base81、剩3；再乘得243，平方base6561、剩1；最后乘得1594323。指数为0时循环不执行，返回乘法单位元1。

n<0时m^n=(1/m)^(-n)。直接Math.abs(Integer.MIN_VALUE)或int n=-n仍会溢出，因为2147483648超出正int范围。代码先long remaining=exponent，再取负，能正确迭代最低int指数，最多32轮。0和-0的负次方先抛ArithmeticException，避免把除0悄悄当业务合法结果。

底数负号由乘法自然保留：奇指数负、偶指数正；负指数亦遵循同一规则。输入NaN/无穷拒绝，结果却仍可能因真实double范围溢出为带符号无穷或下溢为带符号0，这在本契约中保留，调用者需要精确结果则必须换表示。仅以“有限输入”不能保证有限输出。

本实现不是Math.pow的逐位替代或它的精度保证。重复平方的舍入可能放大，尤其底数接近1而指数极大时；不能由O(log n)算术步数推出固定相对误差。测试选定范围内与Math.pow比较用1e-11相对容忍，并对0/无穷比较符号位，这只是所测输入的证据。

模幂每次乘完取 mod，仍需解决乘法溢出；负指数只有在逆元存在时才有对应定义。精确大整数 m^n 的结果位数约为 n log|m|，乘法不再是常数时间，O(log n) 只是大整数乘法次数。浮点近似、模值与任意长精确整数是三个不同的返回合同。

例子与推演

测试覆盖 ±0、正负幂、±1、int 最小和最大指数、2^1024 溢出、2^MIN 下溢、非法底数和零的负指数。此接口选择 0^0=1；需要其他定义时，应调整入口校验。

复杂度与正确性

固定宽度double/int模型下O(log(|n|+1))时间、O(1)额外空间；本实现迭代无递归栈。对固定32位指数最多32轮，算法分析仍以指数位数说明伸缩关系。

边界、反例与追问

若要求不能出现浮点误差或要输出全部大整数位，须先补数值范围/返回类型；不会用未给出的样例或库限制伪造唯一题意。

完整Java与独立穷举/边界验证

示例代码（尚未验证运行结果）
import java.util.*;

/** Finite double base, signed int exponent. 0^0=1 by this API's convention; 0^negative rejects. */
public final class FastPower {
    public static double pow(double base, int exponent) {
        if (!Double.isFinite(base)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("finite base required");
        if (base == 0.0 && exponent < 0) throw new ArithmeticException("zero reciprocal");
        long remaining = exponent; // Widen before negating Integer.MIN_VALUE.
        if (remaining < 0) { base = 1.0 / base; remaining = -remaining; }
        double result = 1.0;
        while (remaining != 0) {
            if ((remaining & 1L) != 0) result *= base;
            remaining >>>= 1;
            if (remaining != 0) base *= base;
        }
        return result;
    }
    static void check(boolean b) { if (!b) throw new AssertionError(); }
    static void compare(double b, int n) {
        double actual = pow(b,n), expected = Math.pow(b,n);
        if (Double.isInfinite(expected) || expected == 0.0) check(Double.doubleToLongBits(actual) == Double.doubleToLongBits(expected));
        else check(Math.abs(actual - expected) <= 1e-11 * Math.abs(expected));
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int tests = 0;
        for (double b : new double[]{-3,-2,-1,-0.5,-0.0,0.0,0.5,1,2,3}) for (int n = -40; n <= 40; n++) {
            if (b == 0 && n < 0) continue; compare(b,n); tests++;
        }
        Random random = new Random(20261009);
        for (int i = 0; i < 10000; i++) { double b = 0.5 + 1.5 * random.nextDouble(); if (random.nextBoolean()) b = -b; compare(b,random.nextInt(401)-200); tests++; }
        check(pow(1,Integer.MIN_VALUE)==1 && pow(-1,Integer.MIN_VALUE)==1 && pow(-1,Integer.MAX_VALUE)==-1);
        compare(2,Integer.MIN_VALUE); compare(2,1024); compare(-2,1025);
        check(pow(0,0) == 1);
        try { pow(0,-1); throw new AssertionError(); } catch (ArithmeticException expected) { }
        for (double bad : new double[]{Double.NaN,Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY,Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY}) try { pow(bad,1); throw new AssertionError(); } catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) { }
        System.out.println("PASS " + tests + " finite comparisons within stated1e-11 relative test tolerance;signed zero/extreme exponent/overflow/underflow;0^0 convention;invalid rejection");
    }
}
